allocation_experiment.controls: Keep total training frames, optimizer cadence, PPO settings and seed source matched. Measure wall time/resources separately from learning; varying N/T changes trajectory segmentation and sample correlation.

duration_experiment.controls: Match original420+Adam, seeds, reward, discount, rollout shape, minibatches, learning rate and PPO passes. Training exposure is the intended intervention.
duration_experiment.endpoint_design: Prefer prespecified checkpoints along fresh longer trajectories, subject to final registration. Endpoints on one trajectory are paired observations, not independent training replicas.
duration_experiment.prediction: More exposure may improve an undertrained policy, plateau, overfit the training pool or degrade performance. Low KL or flat losses alone do not establish convergence.
duration_experiment.question: Does additional PPO training improve the control or rays policy beyond the current short screen?

launch_requirements: Separate frozen local packet, resource/time qualification, fixed evaluation contract and normal exact lease ownership; no concurrent accelerator run or extension of066.
